response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT s.entrystat, AVG(se.ambictemp) as avg_temp, AVG(se.imgcount) as avg_images FROM scanenvironment se INNER JOIN sites s ON se.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, avg_temp, avg_images, avg_images - AVG(avg_images) OVER () as diff FROM status_averages
